discussion: When a user authenticates to the encryption functionality of IT equipment or media, encrypted data is made available. At such a time, the IT equipment or media should be handled according to its original sensitivity or classification. Once the user deauthenticates from the encryption functionality, such as by locking encrypted media, shutting down a device or activating a lock screen, the IT equipment or media can be considered protected by the encryption functionality again.
section_path: Handling encrypted IT equipment and media
title: When a user authenticates to the encryption functionality of IT equipment or media, it is treated in accordance with its original sensitivity or classification until the user deauthenticates from the encryption functionality.
